{{Quote|Are you familiar with the Intergalactic Communications Center on Praesitlyn, in the Sluis sector?|[[Nejaa Halcyon]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="JT" />}}
'''Praesitlyn''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was the location of the [[Intergalactic Communications Center]], a major [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] hub in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Communications Center became a strategic asset during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], leading to the fierce [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].

==Description==
Praesitlyn was located along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]],<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was localized within 60 [[Light-year/Legends|light-year]] of [[Bpfassh]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> The [[Forest/Legends|forested]] planet was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the [[Intergalactic Communications Center]], which acted as a key [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] relay for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The center was located 150 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the center of a major continent. The planet was buffeted by sudden [[Sandstorm/Legends|dust storms]].

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|As we speak, a fleet of one hundred twenty-six ships, seventy-five of them capital ships, is investing Sluis Van to block any reinforcements from that sector. I am at this very moment landing a force of fifty thousand battle droids on Praesitlyn in a feint to divert the garrison from the Intergalactic Communications Center. When that operation is fully under way, I will land the main force, composed of, give or take, a million battle droids, crush the defenders in a containment maneuver, and capture the center intact. I have two hundred ships in my invasion fleet. This operation cannot possibly fail. I guarantee you that within twenty-four standard hours of the commencement of Operation Case White, Praesitlyn will be ours. We will sit firmly astride the communications link that connects the worlds of the Republic. Our forces will be poised at this strategic crossroads to strike without warning at any of the Republic's allies. Most important, our control of Praesitlyn will be a vibroblade thrust directly at Coruscant itself. This is the move that will win the war for us. They'll never know what hit them, those technicians down there and their security forces. They'll soon all be dead-or be assets belonging to us.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]], to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="JT" />}}
The Praesitlyn system seceded with the entire Sluis sector from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN49" /> However, the Intergalactic Communications Center remained under Republic control.<ref name="TCSWE" /> A short time later, agents of [[Eriadu Customs and Immigration]] apprehended the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Tandleroff's Trove]]'' while it was passing through [[Phelar Port/Legends|Phelar Port]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. They found 144 [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|hailfire droids]] destined to Praesitlyn.<ref name="HNN55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|business/1359_1.html|IBC Denies Arming Separatists}}</ref>

[[File:Trial_Cropped.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Battle of Praesitlyn]].]]
At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic recaptured Praesitlyn. As the planet had few defenses, the Republic considered to dispatch reinforcements from the nearby [[Sluis Van Shipyards]]. Nevertheless, the Separatists responded by a major offensive against Praesitlyn, combined with the [[Battle of Sluis Van (Clone Wars)|blockade]] of [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Due to the intense fightings at Praesitlyn and the neighboring systems during the war, one of the main theaters of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] was named after the planet.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the Separatist attempt to conquer the planet and the communications center, a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of 200 starships and a ground force of 50,000 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] under the commander of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pors Tonith/Legends|Pors Tonith]] invaded the system. They were opposed by the [[Praesitlyn Defense Force]], the [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group led by [[Zozridor Slayke]], and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] reinforcements led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Nejaa Halcyon]]. In several weeks of fighting, the Separatists were expelled in the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]], leading to Anakin Skywalker's elevation to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="JT" />

===Later history===
The Intergalactic Communications Center remained in use during the [[New Republic era]].<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> By the time of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], Praesitlyn was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Zilar]].<ref name="SoL" /><ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Sluis sector and, consequently, Praesitlyn, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
